title: OpenElf 形象工坊授权
description: 使用 OpenElf API Key 连接形象工坊，密钥只保存在本地，不会同步到其他服务。
description_en: Connect with your OpenElf API Key. The key is stored locally only and never synced.
docLabel: 如何获取 OpenElf API Key？
docLabel_en: How to get an OpenElf API Key?

fields.label: OpenElf API Key
fields.description: 在 OpenElf 开放平台控制台创建 API Key，格式为 oe-sk- 开头；如提示未授权，请检查密钥是否已吊销或额度是否用尽。
fields.description_en: Create an API key in the OpenElf console. It starts with oe-sk-. If unauthorized, check whether the key was revoked or the quota is exhausted.
